The coordinated release is aimed at heading off further price spikes and avoiding a ban on US diesel exports.

The rise in global oil prices has been pushing up the pump prices of petrol and diesel in the UK.

[BBC Business] US jobs market sees sharp slowdown ahead of midterm elections
Unemployment rose slightly as American employers paused hiring with midterm elections just a month away.

[CNBC] Men are losing ground in the labor market. Here's why

A weak U.S. labor report did what bad news hadn’t done in a while: It made U.S. debt look like a safe haven again — albeit briefly.
